caption_txt.title: South Australia Has Opened Its Nomination Program! 🇦🇺📢
body: South Australia has recently opened its nomination program for this financial year, but only for clients whose visa is going to expire on 31 January 2027. If you are one of them, you can submit your ROI. There is a reason they have mentioned this date: they might prioritise your case, and you can be invited if you meet all other nomination requirements.

For overseas clients, you don't need to submit an ROI for South Australia. You can submit your EOI and you will be invited through the EOI itself. Want to know more? Our Registered Migration Agent Rahul Dhanda (MARN 2418640) and the PFEC team can help, so get in touch with us today.
